offerings.name: Search
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Real-time search with token-efficient page contents; standard search results with URLs and page contents, plus AI summary and structured outputs
offerings.note: Additional results above 10: $1 / 1k results; AI page summaries: $1 / 1k pages. Enterprise supports up to 1,000 results per search.

offerings.name: Deep Search (deep-lite, deep)
offerings.price_basis: PAYG /search type=deep-lite or deep base price (up to 10 results)
offerings.free_quota: New accounts get $20 in free credits (around 2,800 searches) and the Free Tier adds $10 in credits every month.
offerings.output_type: Multi-step research with structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: Latency ~4 seconds for deep-lite, 4–15 seconds for deep. Additional results and AI page summaries cost the same as standard search.

offerings.output_type: Multi-step research with structured outputs and citations
offerings.note: Latency 12–40 seconds; best for harder research tasks. Additional results and AI page summaries cost the same as standard search.
